spec2def(cryptdlg.dll cryptdlg.spec)

# cryptdlg.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cryptdlg-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(cryptdlg_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(cryptdlg_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libuser32 libcrypt32 libcryptui libwintrust libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(cryptdlg_shims)
add_cargo_module(cryptdlg cryptdlg-cargo cryptdlg.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cryptdlg_shims psdk)
